releaseNotes:
• 1-Click Universal Content Extractor: Extracts all articles from any website (WordPress, Ghost, Substack, Medium, Shopify, Webflow, Hugo, Astro, Next.js, or custom CMS) via RSS, Sitemaps, REST API, & DOM crawling
• Delete button on every article card, website card, and list view row
• Mobile Long-Press gesture support: Haptic feedback + action sheet to delete, edit, or move cards
• Ultra-responsive zero-overlap mobile header with streamlined brand & actions dock
